items.example: They use 13 kilos of coffee beans a year.
items.mnemonic: На жаре a jar of coffee beans — банка кофейных зёрен.

items.example: People in the UK drink about eight cups of tea a day.
items.mnemonic: Капля чая: a cup of tea — чашка чая.

items.example: How much mineral water do you drink a day?
items.mnemonic: Батл за воду: a bottle of water — бутылка воды.

items.example: A can of soft drink has about seven spoonfuls of sugar.
items.mnemonic: Спонсор с ложкой: a spoonful of sugar — ложка сахара.

items.example: On average, people drink two litres of water a day.
items.mnemonic: Авария в среднем раз в год: on average — в среднем.

items.example: How much food does an average person eat in their lifetime?
items.mnemonic: Лайфхак на всю жизнь: in their lifetime — за свою жизнь.

items.example: We eat quite a lot of beans in Russia.
items.mnemonic: Кваса quite a lot — довольно много.

items.example: He doesn't drink much coffee and he hasn't got many hobbies.
items.mnemonic: Мачо пьёт not much coffee — немного кофе.

items.example: How many kilos of coffee does a person use in a year?
items.mnemonic: Шотландец в килте взвешивает how many kilos — сколько килограммов.

items.example: How many times does a six-year-old child laugh every day?
items.mnemonic: Таймер считает how many times — сколько раз.

items.example: Yoghurt comes in a big plastic bottle.
items.mnemonic: Йогурт приезжает на камазе: come in a bottle — продаваться в бутылке.

items.example: The top coffee-drinkers in the world are from Finland.
items.mnemonic: Финны в топе: the top coffee-drinkers — лучшие любители кофе.
